purpose: Two owner-directed offline checks: (a) re-examine the recorded N1 'Geofabrik mutated its dated extract' finding; (b) measure peak bus-session concurrency to test the interpretation section's density-band inference.

n1_reexamination.verdict: N1 AS RECORDED IS WITHDRAWN: no provider mutation occurred and the pin never failed.

root_cause_of_the_false_finding.observation: source_extract.bytes (996913352) and the 233af3fa sha are byte-identical to decode.decoded_bytes and decode.decoded_sha256; the record therefore stored the DECODED XML's identity in the source-extract fields.
root_cause_of_the_false_finding.consequence: The recorded source md5 (b7fa4a2a, computed over decoded XML) was compared against the provider's published md5 for the COMPRESSED pbf (c73b16ec) and necessarily mismatched. The mismatch was recorded as a warning rather than failing closed, and on 27 July the smaller correct file was misread as evidence of upstream mutation.

decisive_confirmation.method: osmium cat -f osm over the on-disk 50.5 MB pbf, 2.665 s
decisive_confirmation.meaning: The artifact the continuity audit called 'not re-derivable externally' is deterministically re-derived from the file currently on disk.

consequences: The Greater Manchester network chain is rebuildable now from a verified-correct, provider-checksum-matching input; no new network identity is forced.
The demand cascade's dependency on N1 is released; N1 is no longer a blocker of the recorded kind.
No public claim that Geofabrik mutated a dated file may be made; the superseded claim is retained in the continuity audit with a dated correction.

peak_concurrency_measurement.purpose: Settle the density-band inference in the bus results interpretation section.
peak_concurrency_measurement.method: Offline extraction over the 52 verified peak quarantines (2026-07-28T07Z range) under a fresh in-process session salt; distinct session pseudonyms counted per snapshot; 'concurrently live' requires a fix within 120 s of that snapshot's latest recorded time. Aggregates only.
peak_concurrency_measurement.verdict: MEASURED AND CONFIRMED: peak bus concurrency (~1,192-1,216) falls inside the capacity sweep's unresolved band - about 5.6x the densest normal trace and about 48% of the collapse hour.
limits: Session pseudonyms are session-scoped; counts are not comparable across sessions.
Concurrency of a derived B1 trace is not identical to feed concurrency; slot construction is a separate step.
This is bus-fleet support, never road traffic volume, and no experiment is implied.
